cases.given: new focus session; approved background selection inputs
cases.requiredResult: select once, lock snapshot
cases.approvalOrBoundary: art candidate set and selection policy required

cases.given: locked focus; date/period/skin changes
cases.requiredResult: base ID and selection token unchanged
cases.approvalOrBoundary: reselect next session only

cases.given: locked focus; valid activity changes coding -> AI
cases.requiredResult: re-evaluate presentation channels; base unchanged
cases.approvalOrBoundary: action priority only if conflicting owners overlap

cases.given: coffee overlay active; coding or AI active; compatible overlay layout
cases.requiredResult: overlay and selected activity coexist; base unchanged
cases.approvalOrBoundary: overlay must claim no hand/body/face and pass visual constraints

cases.given: coffee drink and coding both claim same hand/body
cases.requiredResult: requires approved conflict policy; never concurrent conflicting ownership
cases.approvalOrBoundary: winner / wait / discard / safe interruption undecided

cases.given: coffee overlay visible; approved drink admitted
cases.requiredResult: may coexist only if scene assets and cup identity protocol compatible
cases.approvalOrBoundary: not automatic linkage; never duplicate same logical cup

cases.given: AI and music facts active; approved recipes have disjoint claims
cases.requiredResult: both facts retained and both presentations allowed
cases.approvalOrBoundary: needs approved assets; do not assume headphones compatible

cases.given: AI and music both require same body channel
cases.requiredResult: one compatible presentation set selected by approved policy
cases.approvalOrBoundary: do not infer AI always wins from V1 legacy primary

cases.given: two selected activity recipes require different semantic faces
cases.requiredResult: at most one face owner; conflict policy or recipe without face needed
cases.approvalOrBoundary: never mix semantic face paths

cases.given: AI sources A and B active; A stop
cases.requiredResult: remove A only; AI stays true due to B; re-evaluate once
cases.approvalOrBoundary: stop must identify source instance/order; no clear-all

cases.given: last AI source stops/expires
cases.requiredResult: AI fact inactive; release its eligible presentation; re-evaluate others
cases.approvalOrBoundary: focus base and unrelated coffee/music persist

cases.given: music/coding/AI active; user disables detection
cases.requiredResult: invalidate detection epoch, revoke detection facts, release derived intents
cases.approvalOrBoundary: manual coffee, needs, focus base persist

cases.given: off -> on; old sample queued
cases.requiredResult: reject old epoch; wait fresh qualified sample
cases.approvalOrBoundary: do not restore cached old activity

cases.given: AI signal expires while renderer hidden/frozen
cases.requiredResult: expire fact by fact clock; before visible resume re-evaluate and cancel old intent
cases.approvalOrBoundary: owner face freeze does not freeze TTL

cases.given: browser foreground or V1 focus-browse selected; no new detector
cases.requiredResult: no detected browse fact
cases.approvalOrBoundary: focus-browse source is not OS detection

cases.given: AI application foreground; no valid prompt hook
cases.requiredResult: no AI-active fact solely from foreground
cases.approvalOrBoundary: consistent with V1 classifier source

cases.given: hunger and deepNightIdle persist without input changes
cases.requiredResult: facts coexist; idempotent stable presentation decision
cases.approvalOrBoundary: product chooses display priority; no alternating maintenance state

cases.given: drag/pet suppresses coffee action or activity
cases.requiredResult: retain underlying valid facts; own action resources cleanly interrupted
cases.approvalOrBoundary: body-wide interaction priority and resumption policy require approval

cases.given: interaction ends after AI expired and coffee fact remains
cases.requiredResult: re-evaluate current facts; do not resume expired AI or repeat consumed drink
cases.approvalOrBoundary: new lifetime for any newly selected face

cases.given: multiple source changes at identical canonical time
cases.requiredResult: apply complete fact batch then evaluate once
cases.approvalOrBoundary: no intermediate flicker or source-order-dependent oscillation

cases.given: cup or background load fails before compound action admission
cases.requiredResult: no partial channel ownership; rollback acquired leases; report blocked
cases.approvalOrBoundary: no automatic unapproved replacement asset

cases.given: locked session ends; new focus begins
cases.requiredResult: release old session base; choose from new captured context once
cases.approvalOrBoundary: same art ID allowed if deterministic selection repeats

cases.given: old focus or action loading; session ends/restarts or plan revoked; old result resolves late
cases.requiredResult: reject stale session/plan generation, release acquired leases; current locked base and owners unchanged
cases.approvalOrBoundary: each async result must identify session/source epoch/plan generation

cases.given: missing conflict rule, cyclic preference or ambiguous unstable equal-rank plan
cases.requiredResult: reject configuration before activation; no resource acquisition or channel-order-dependent winner
cases.approvalOrBoundary: stable tie rule remains product decision; no implicit priority constants
